# AirPodsMode v0.3.3-preview

## Why Adaptive was missing
Bluetooth name for Pro 2 / Pro 3 is often just **"AirPods Pro"** (no generation).  
`fromName()` mapped that bare name to **AirPods Pro 1**, which has `supportsAdaptive = false`, so the Adaptive button was hidden.

## Fixes
1. **Adaptive always shown** for Pro 2 / Pro 3 / AirPods 4 ANC / unknown Pro-named devices. Bare "AirPods Pro" → optimistic UNKNOWN (Adaptive ON), not Pro 1. UI uses `showAdaptiveInUi()` so failed PID detection no longer hides Adaptive.
2. **最后位置** — main-screen card + settings entry open a dedicated screen with OSM map preview, lat/lng, time, address, open-in-Maps, clear/refresh, and a checklist (notifications + location + FGS connect then disconnect). Deep link: `airpodsmode://last-location`.
